findings.element: overlay.html — metadata-key validation error (scope-key and refine-row 'cond-i' error slots)
findings.finding: R10 specifies the blocking message for a metadata source with no key as 'Enter the metadata key to match on.', but the prototype shows 'Name the Stripe field that holds the reference.' in both the field-level error and the alert-banner summary.
findings.user_impact: The save-blocking reason a user reads does not match the wording the FDD requires, so the acceptance criterion for this validation message is not met even though the block itself fires correctly.
findings.suggested_fix: Replace 'Name the Stripe field that holds the reference.' with 'Enter the metadata key to match on.' in validate() (both the scope-key and cond-i branches) and in the SHORT lookup used for the alert banner and bar message.

evidence.quote: Enter the metadata key to match on.

findings.element: overlay.html — 'Then refine' row when 'On the invoice' is set to 'Invoice number in books'
findings.finding: R13 requires that the 21-character limit and truncation be stated on the field wherever a DocNumber comparison is made; the tip is rendered only under the scope invoice-number row (s.match.on) and never appears under a refine row whose target is doc_number.
findings.user_impact: A user who builds a refine condition against 'Invoice number in books' is not told that long values get truncated to 21 characters before comparing, so a rule that silently matches on a truncated string can look like a bug.
findings.suggested_fix: Render the same 21-character tip under any refine row where ct-i ("on the invoice") resolves to doc_number, not only under the scope match row.

evidence.quote: the character limit and truncation must be stated on the field

gaps: Guard behaviour (R8): the state map exercised the Customer checkbox and the invoice-number-match checkbox independently (each true→false→true) but never both off at once, so the blocking-guard message was never actually observed on screen in this pass — only inferred from source.

Update/Close commit paths: 'Close without saving' and 'Update' are flagged in the state map itself as not exercised during recon (exercised in a dedicated pass), so the GSP-side result of a successful save — chip flip to 'Custom rule', rule-summary line, and R21's retain-configuration-after-disable behaviour — is unverified here.

Plan gate (R22) and Generic customer (R24): the presenter-bar plan selector and 'Generic customer' toggle were not exercised in this recon pass, so the Starter-plan block and the Generic-customer narrowing note are confirmed from source only, not from an observed interaction.
reference_gaps: No Figma frames exist for this feature (reference.json note) — only a text FDD extract, so layout/spacing/visual-design fidelity cannot be judged against a design reference, only functional and copy presence against the normative rules.
R27 requires the feature to 'have a marketable name' but the FDD supplies none, so the working title 'Payment application' used throughout the prototype cannot be judged compliant or non-compliant.

Q3 (default finite N, self-serve maximum N, and the snapshot-page ceiling) is explicitly unresolved in the FDD; the prototype's values (default 30, max 365, no stated snapshot ceiling) are documented in-UI as assumption A3 and cannot be checked against a spec'd number.

Q1/Q2 (case-insensitivity and 21-character-truncation confirmation) are unresolved in the FDD; the prototype implements both as assumptions, so their correctness cannot be judged against a confirmed rule.
